info.name: Limble API V2 Assets Vendors API

params.name: fields
params.description: This parameter is used to only get specific fields by ID. This parameter expects a comma delimited list of fieldIDs.

params.name: name
params.description: This parameter is used to only get specific field by name. This parameter expects a string full name of a field or partial name with the wildcard %.

params.name: vendors
params.description: This parameter is used to only get specific Vendors. This parameter expects a comma delimited list of Vendor IDs.

params.name: start
params.description: This parameter is used to only get vendor fields for vendors that were last edited after the unix timestamp passed into the start parameter. For example, all Vendors that were last edited after April 18th, 2018.

params.name: end
params.description: This parameter is used to only get vendor fields for vendors that were last edited *before* the unix timestamp passed into the end parameter.

params.name: cursor
params.description: This parameter is a cursor that selects what fieldID you want to start receiving results at. e.g. passing 137 here will only get you vendor fields with an id greater than 137.

params.name: limit
params.description: This parameter is a result limiter. The default is set to return no more than 100 results at one time.

params.name: value
params.description: This parameter is used to only get specific field by value. This parameter expects a string full name of a field or partial name with the wildcard %.

params.name: page
params.description: This parameter is used to paginate results based on the limit. Refer to Pagination section for more information.

params.name: values
params.description: This parameter is used to get vendor fields by their valueID. This parameter expects a comma delimited list of Value IDs.

This call returns a "meta" object containing URLs that can be used to get data related to a vendor.

This call will also return an image array of objects that have a file name and a link you can use to download that image. All links are only valid for 15 minutes, a new call will generate a new link.

**Note:** this endpoint supports pagination. Please refer to the [**Pagination**](#pagination) section for more information.

email | string | Optional | The Vendor's email address.
contact | string | Optional | The Vendor's primary contact.
phone | string | Optional | The Vendor's phone number.
address | string | Optional | The Vendor's address.
